public_rationale: The evidence does not settle the claim. Ramp reports concentrated spending, not that customers supplying 80% of total revenue cannot afford their bills. Neither concentration nor losses alone proves the whole assertion.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: OpenAI and Anthropic are very unprofitable and unstable, with 80% of revenue from companies that can't afford to pay them.

statement.excerpt: OpenAI and Anthropic are horrifyingly unprofitable, deeply unstable, and as I’ve discussed, 80% of their revenues come from companies that literally can’t afford to pay them, and yet the markets never react, because this information doesn’t really matter as long as the right numbers keep going up.

from_speaker: companies that literally can’t afford to pay them
our_interpretation: Read as applying to each company separately, rather than an unspecified combined revenue pool.
Use July–September 2026, the latest completed calendar quarter before the post, for the ongoing financial observation. The speaker supplies no reporting period.
The ordinary reading requires substantial losses, serious financial fragility, and approximately 80% of realized revenue coming from customers unable to meet their payment obligations.
Being unprofitable, venture-funded, or a large customer does not by itself establish inability to pay.
The metric scope records the numerical revenue-share assertion. Profitability and financial stability require separate financial measures.
The supplied passage identifies no accounting basis or specific financial source. Do not infer one from subsequently found evidence.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable evidence for both companies establishes substantial losses and financial fragility during the target period, and customer-level revenue and liquidity records establish the approximately 80% share.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable evidence establishes profitability or financial resilience inconsistent with the claim, or establishes that materially less than 80% of either company's realized revenue came from customers unable to pay. A missing disclosure alone is not contradiction.
